summary: Iteration 7 P2 items: (1) shadcn Calendar migration on /rentals/:id and (2) new /rentals/inbox owner page. Backend: 93/93 tests pass (full regression including 17 in test_lumo_admin_and_overlap.py + 11 in test_lumo_rentals.py + 30 across other suites). The newly enriched GET /api/rental-bookings/mine?role=owner endpoint returns rental{title,category,media_url} on every booking — verified via curl as provider@lumo.test (8 bookings, 8/8 enriched, sample: 'TEST_overlap_rental' / category 'tools_equipment' / media_url populated). Frontend code review of /app/frontend/src/pages/RentalDetail.jsx, /app/frontend/src/pages/RentalInbox.jsx, /app/frontend/src/components/NavBar.jsx, and /app/frontend/src/App.js confirms all 12 acceptance criteria from the request are wired correctly (testids match the spec, Protected wrapper on /rentals/inbox, react-day-picker disabled matcher uses both blocked-dates API + past-day check, end-date matcher additionally guards against ranges spanning a blocked window starting after start_date). End-to-end playwright UI verification could NOT be completed because the preview URL returns the Emergent 'Preview Unavailable!!!' (Sherpa anti-bot) page only when accessed by the playwright/Chromium tool (curl returns 200 OK on the same URL). Tried 3 times with reloads + 30s/60s waits. Recommend main agent verify the new Calendar popover + Inbox UI in a real browser session — code-level correctness has been confirmed.
action_items: Main agent: please manually verify in a real browser (not the testing tool) that (a) the Jan-2099 booked range 10-14 on TEST_overlap_rental rental id a31a6ef4-ef01-48e3-9690-0707ae32097f shows greyed-out dates inside the Calendar popover and (b) clicking the navbar Inbox icon as provider@lumo.test routes to /rentals/inbox with 8 rows. Backend behaviour and component wiring are confirmed correct via curl + code review.
critical_code_review_comments: RentalDetail.jsx 33-65: toISO/fromISO helpers are correct (local-tz, padded). dayDisabled = past || in any blocked range using half-open [start,end) interval — matches backend overlap query. endDayDisabled additionally rejects end <= start and any range whose start_date falls within [start_date, end) — correctly preventing a booking from spanning across a blocked window. After picking a new start_date, end_date is cleared if it was on/before the new start (line 224) — good.

RentalDetail.jsx 210-230: shadcn Popover + CalendarPicker integration is idiomatic; trigger Button retains data-testid='rental-start-date' so existing tests still target it; same for rental-end-date at 236.

RentalInbox.jsx 176 lines, well under 700; all required data-testids present (inbox-back, inbox-host-cta, inbox-stats, inbox-tabs, inbox-filter-{6}, inbox-list, inbox-empty, inbox-row-{id}, inbox-rental-link-{id}, inbox-approve-{id}, inbox-decline-{id}). useAuth guards correctly: user===undefined shows loading, !user/false redirects via Navigate.
RentalInbox.jsx 89-98: pending-tab amber badge only renders when count > 0 — correct.
RentalInbox.jsx 117: media_url path is normalised to absolute URL only when relative — handles both inline-uploaded and external picsum URLs.
server.py 1565: rentals lookup uses projection that explicitly excludes _id ({'_id': 0}), so the embedded rental object never leaks Mongo ObjectId — good.
server.py 1570: media_url falls back from media[0].media_url to legacy media_url field — backwards compatible.
NavBar.jsx 101: nav-rental-inbox NavLink is rendered conditionally (only when user is signed in via the surrounding render block) — correct gating.
App.js route uses <Protected> wrapper around <RentalInbox/> — consistent with other auth-gated routes.

success_rate.backend: 100% (93/93 regression incl. 30 directly relevant: 17 admin/overlap + 11 rental booking flow + 2 multi-media)
success_rate.frontend: code-review only (100% wiring correctness on all touched files). Live playwright run blocked by Sherpa anti-bot — see action items.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is solid (93/93). For frontend the playwright tool was being blocked by 'Preview Unavailable!!!' (Sherpa bot detection) even though curl shows HTTP 200 — if this recurs, try waiting 60-120s between runs or run the script with longer initial wait_for_timeout(8000) before first action.
